title: Love as High as the Sky
story: Bless the Lord, O My Soul
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A man named David sang a song,
'Oh bless the Lord, my soul!
I will remember all the good
He does that makes me whole.'

[Chorus]
As high as sky above the earth,
That's how big God loves you,
And when you're sorry, He takes your
Mistakes far, far from view.

[Verse 2]
He's kind, He helps us when we're sad,
He fills our lives with good,
'He loves us,' David sang, 'just like
The best of daddies would.'

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and know His love
Reaches up to the sky,
So big, so gentle, all for you,
As you sleep, He's close by.

[Chorus]
mood: Soaring music. A wide, slow sway that lifts on each phrase like arms opening toward the sky, matching a story about love as high as the heavens and mistakes sent far away. The pulse is warm and full, more praise than hurry. By the last verse it comes down gently, lower and slower, the wide lift settling into a close, quiet hold.
